publisher_assessment.decision: Thirty-five official external references are accepted with item-specific scope limits, including current Finnish statutes, official agency guidance, discovery and service locators, court information and oversight material. Two Finnish current-law text conversions are accepted as dated local copies after source and replay checks. One obsolete Migri route is dispositioned as already represented by a current EU-family page and wrong-scope for EU free movement. Two official oversight sites remain under human review. No topic or whole-country completion is accepted.
publisher_assessment.basis: The Finlex site identifies its government ownership and maintenance, labels consolidated laws as current, and exposes versioned ELI identifiers. Direct page links provide a usable government-published text without requiring API registration, a local conversion pipeline, or a reconstruction of Gazette fragments.
publisher_assessment.limitation: External-reference acceptance is limited to the listed page identities and item scopes; it does not certify every statement on dynamic guidance pages or establish topic coverage. Several Migri and DVV pages were confirmed through official-site search results or official links after the research viewer returned 403. The Parliamentary Ombudsman English brochure was identified on its official domain, but the site root was not accessible. The two accepted local Finnish copies are dated captures and were not independently compared clause by clause with publisher pages.
